dag.description: XGBoost complete end-to-end pipeline for a regional Returns-and-Refunds reversal-reclassification model (e.g. rnr_regional). A single calibration-split inference fans out to (a) ModelMetricsComputation -> ModelWikiGenerator for a published model wiki and (b) PercentileModelCalibration that feeds Package -> Registration. No separate held-out testing branch.

agent_context.when_to_use: XGBoost tabular classifier (e.g. rnr_regional reversal-reclassification model) that needs BOTH a published model wiki AND percentile-bucket score calibration before packaging. One inference on the calibration split feeds both the metrics/wiki branch and the percentile-calibration branch.
agent_context.when_not_to_use: If you calibrate with sigmoid/isotonic ModelCalibration (use xgboost_complete_e2e_with_wiki_and_model_calibration). If you do not need a wiki (use xgboost_percentile_e2e). If you also run a separate held-out testing branch (use xgboost_complete_e2e_with_calibration_and_testing).
differentiators: Uses PercentileModelCalibration (bucketed scores) together with a ModelWikiGenerator wiki on the same calibration split
Single XGBoostModelInference_calibration forks to metrics/wiki AND percentile calibration - no redundant second inference
No separate held-out testing branch: wiki metrics come from the calibration split

prerequisites.check: Training + calibration Cradle SQL / dataset splits
prerequisites.how: two Cradle SQL blocks (or two job_type splits)
ModelMetricsComputation requires labels on the calibration split

common_pitfalls: Package registers the PercentileModelCalibration output, not raw XGBoostTraining
Both branches share the one XGBoostModelInference_calibration - do not duplicate the inference step
